licenseTypesIncluded: Massachusetts Home Improvement Contractor registrations exposed by the MA Contractor Hub search
knownExclusions: This source is limited to Home Improvement Contractor registration and does not replace a Construction Supervisor License, trade license, building permit, or local authorization.
The official program states HIC registration is different from a Construction Supervisor License.
New construction, commercial work, public-building certification, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, sheet-metal, asbestos, and local permits require separate source paths.

publicRecordsNotes: Official registration-search metadata only. Absence from this source is not proof that a license, registration, permit, or authorization does not exist elsewhere.
officialLookupReviewNotes: The MA Contractor Hub exposes a public Home Improvement Contractor Registration and History Search.
officialBulkDownloadNotes: No stable official bulk download or redistribution-safe export was confirmed during this review.
researchNotes: This entry separates HIC registration from OPSI construction supervisor licensing and DOL trade licenses.
verificationCaveats: HIC registration is not interchangeable with a Construction Supervisor License or trade license.
No matching record means no match in the checked Contractor Hub source at the checked time, not proof that another credential or local authorization does not exist.
verificationNotes: No supported adapter is exposed while the Contractor Hub lookup shape and allowed reuse remain under review.
maintainerNotes: Future adapters must preserve registration history, checked time, source URL, caveats, privacy review, and raw record fingerprint.
